details: Bitcoin broke above $80,000 on Monday, continuing its rally and causing over $220 million in crypto short positions to be liquidated within 24 hours. This marks Bitcoin's best August performance since 2017, and analysts are now watching for sustained strength above key moving averages to confirm a lasting bullish trend.
title: Bitcoin Price Surges Past $80K, Triggers $220M in Short Liquidations

details: Ethereum completed a major structural breakout, surging to about $2.55K before encountering significant resistance and pulling back to $2.39K. Analysts suggest a potential corrective phase after the rapid ascent, with crucial support identified at the $2.07K-$2.15K breaker block.
title: Ethereum's Rally Hits Resistance After Breaking Out to $2.55K

details: Institutional investors are expanding their crypto holdings beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum, with nearly $90 million flowing into altcoin exchange-traded funds in the past week. Solana's ETFs show notable growth, reflecting increased institutional access and a focus on liquid, high market-cap alternative cryptocurrencies.
title: Wall Street Diversifies: $90M Inflows into Altcoin ETFs

details: The SEC has introduced "Regulation Crypto Assets," a framework for investment contracts involving crypto assets not considered securities. It outlines "startup" and "fundraising" exemptions for capital raising, aiming to provide regulatory clarity and defined pathways for crypto issuers under federal securities laws.
title: SEC Proposes New "Regulation Crypto Assets" for Investment Contracts
